dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've seen the Rite of Parting...

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Wow! So you are the rumored foreign Traveler that assisted with the Rite of Parting!

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: I apologize for my rudeness. As one of Rex Lapis' subjects, I need to properly show you my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Please accept my humble gift. Make sure you take it.
